subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage confirmation needed for Acme Health procurement
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II coverage for upcoming contract - urgent

Hi Lukas,

We are finalizing the procurement paperwork for Redwood and have a hard deadline to sign by 2027-05-10. Our security team requires either:
- a current SOC 2 Type II report that covers the contract period, or
- a signed bridge/interim attestation confirming Type II coverage will be in place covering the audit period specified in the contract.

Can you confirm which you can provide and on what timeline? Procurement flagged this as blocking the PO. I attached the relevant RFP snippet.

Thanks,
Alice Jenkins
Director, Vendor Management
Acme Health Systems

[Attachment: acme_rfp_requirements.pdf (48 KB)]

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage for upcoming contract - urgent

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up and the clear timeline. Short answer: we do not yet have a public SOC 2 Type II that reaches the full contract window you requested, but we can provide an interim bridge letter plus a short attestation of expected coverage while the Type II report is finalized.

Marissa — looping you for a commercial perspective (we may need a credit/contract clause tweak if the bridge is time-limited).
Karthik — can security confirm whether we can produce a bridge letter + interim attestation within 72 hours and what evidence we need from the audit team? This is a high-priority unblock for a >$400k ARR opportunity.

Alice — I attached a sketch of the bridge letter we usually use; we will get Karthik to confirm and sign if security approves.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: bridge_letter_draft_v1.docx (14 KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage for upcoming contract - urgent

Lukas / Marissa —

We can produce a signed bridge letter and interim attestation that addresses Acme's ask. Proposed plan (security):
1) Sign and return a bridge letter confirming the current control environment and the expected audit period covered by our Type II report. Template attached.
2) Provide a scoped list of artifacts (control descriptions, change logs, AWS KMS config screenshots, retention policy doc) that the audit team can produce within 48 hours.
3) If Acme requires a notarized attestation or longer evidence package, that will take longer — call this the extended path.

We need help from Marissa on whether Sales can accept a 90-day bridge window (and any offset in SLA/credit language). If Sales wants tighter guarantees, Legal will need to sign off on amended language.

I'll start drafting the bridge letter now and will route to Security Leadership for signature. Expect a draft in ~6 hours.

Karthik
Sr. Security Engineer (Infosec)
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: security_artifact_checklist.txt (2 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II coverage for upcoming contract - urgent

Evelyn — heads up, Acme procurement is blocking signature until we provide SOC2 coverage language. Deal size is material and timeline is tight (signature by 2027-05-10).

Ask: can Sales accept a 60–90 day bridge letter (standard for many prospects) with a clause tying final Type II delivery to contract conditions? If yes, we'll communicate to Acme and push Legal to add simple contract language. If no, we need an exec-level exception or credit.

Lukas — please prep the contract snippet and I will work Legal/Finance. Karthik — appreciate the rapid bridge draft.

-Marissa
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 18:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II coverage for upcoming contract - urgent

Hi Alice — quick update and confirmation:

1) Attached is our signed bridge letter and a short interim attestation from Security confirming the control environment and the expected Type II audit period.
2) We included an artifact checklist (screenshots & docs) we can deliver to your security team within 48 hours if requested.
3) If Acme needs the final Type II report to fall fully inside the contract term, please flag that now; otherwise, the bridge letter covers the standard procurement ask and Legal has agreed to a 90-day bridge window.

Next steps:
- If this looks acceptable, please confirm and we'll route the final signed bridge letter via DocuSign.
- Marissa / Karthik will be available for any follow-up questions your security/procurement teams have.

Thanks for the quick coordination — we're pushing to keep the signature date.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

[Attachment: signed_bridge_letter_acme_20270426.pdf (8 KB)]
